readings: For each media type ID that appears in the Track table, show the average Track.UnitPrice and the ratio of that average to the overall average Track.UnitPrice across all tracks. Leave the numbers unrounded. List the top 10 by ratio, highest first.

For each media type in the MediaType table, including types with no tracks, show the average Track.UnitPrice and the ratio of that average to the overall average Track.UnitPrice across all tracks. Types with no tracks have a NULL average and ratio. Leave the numbers unrounded. List the top 10 by ratio, highest first, with NULL ratios last.

For each media type ID that appears in the Track table, show the average Track.UnitPrice and the ratio of that average to the overall average, where the overall average is the mean of the per-media-type average prices (each media type weighted equally, not each track). Leave the numbers unrounded. List the top 10 by ratio, highest first.
queries:
SELECT MediaTypeId,
       AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
       AVG(UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) AS ratio
FROM Track
GROUP BY MediaTypeId
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) AS ratio
FROM MediaType m
LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH m AS (
  SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)
SELECT MediaTypeId, avg_price, avg_price / (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM m) AS ratio
FROM m
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
